title: Desire: The Turning Point of All Achievement
coreMove: Turn desire into a written compact: exact amount, exchange offered, definite date, plan begun now, and twice-daily rehearsal that trains action to keep looking.

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid mistaking excitement for a goal the team can act on
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist checks the six steps for exact sum, definite date, and twice-daily rehearsal
